title: schedonorus pauciflorus
intro: Schedonorus pauciflorus, commonly known as timothy grass, is a perennial grass species native to Europe and Asia. Timothy grass is valued for its nutritional and medicinal properties, which include providing health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory function. The plant's therapeutic actions include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which can help soothe digestive issues and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Schedonorus pauciflorus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and fatty acids, which contribute to its medicinal and health-promoting effects.
